'''Clan Bk'trugh''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clan whose members wore distinctive [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] and rarely left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], save for times when they were at war.
